content.title: Global Chip Stock Rally Founders on Concerns Over Valuations
content.summary: Shares of Advanced Micro Devices Inc. were more than 4% lower in premarket trading Wednesday, after the chipmaker’s guidance failed to meet investors’ high expectations.  AMD’s results followed a 4.1% decline in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index on Tuesday, the sharpest drop in more than three weeks.  In Asia, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. declined 3%, while losses in Samsung Electronics Co. dragged South Korea’s Kospi benchmark down 2.9%.
